stemMarkdown: A can complete a job in 10 days and B in 24 days. They work together and are paid Rs. 6000 in total. What is A's share (in Rs.)? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Wages are split in the ratio of work done, which is the ratio of their rates: $\dfrac{1}{10} : \dfrac{1}{24} = 24 : 10$. A's share is $\dfrac{24}{34} \times 6000 = 4235.29$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The faster worker earns more — pay follows output, not hours present.
